Nivel de vechime: Nivel mediu de experiență
Tip de angajare: Full-time
Sectoare de activitate: Telecomunicații
How would you like to work in IT, toying with cutting edge technologies and enjoying your life? At Orange Services, it’s possible!
 As one of the largest IT Hub within Orange Group, we are working internationally for both Orange corporate functions and country operations. Through a unique combination of know-how and expertise, our teams provide a broad range of IT & Business Solutions.
 Come closer to #LifeAtOrange!
 Security Engineer
 Location: Bucharest
 What we are looking for 
A Senior Security Engineer with 10+ years of experience in cybersecurity, including security engineering, penetration testing, and/or software development.
Someone to work transversally, with various interlocutors, internally and within the Group, for a wide variety of projects (IT, Cloud, Data IA, Business Intelligence, IoT,..)
 What you need to know/have 
Knowledge of IT technologies
Knowledge of computer security good practices : ISO2700x, NIST, CIS, etc.
Experience with security risk assessment, g. ISO27005 or EBIOS Risk Manager methodology
Familiarity with Cyber Threat Intelligence & Vulnerability Management
Awareness with European and international regulations, such as NIS 2, CRA, and GDPR
Methodological & Rigorous
Result oriented & KPI oriented
Work in an international and multicultural environment
Able to work in a transversal way
Fluent in English; French will be a plus
Autonomous with good capability for team work
Solid interpersonal skills
Technical curiosity
Synthesis skills
 What you’ll be doing 
Work closely with project managers to help them assess and record security risks and to assess follow compliance with the Security by Design program requirements
Organize and facilitate ‘Risk Assessment Advisory’ reviews, to advise projects and measure their sensitivity to cyber risk,
Consolidate the risks and maintain a risk map to report to the Board of Directors
Follow the treatment plans for critical risks
Carry out security risk assessments for strategic projects, using an ISO27005-compliant methodology (ex: EBIOS Risk Manager)
Contribute to the implementation of security policies
 What’s in it for you 
Performance Bonuses – based on your results & the company’s
Electronic Meal Tickets
Medical & Life insurance for you - facilities for your family, too
Professional GSM subscription
Personal GSM subscription, also [because we believe in communication!]
Special grants on Smartphones & devices; discounts for Orange products & services
Development Platforms - Orange Learning, Trainings, Career Counselling, Coaching & Career plan mentoring
Wellbeing Programs – we support your Zen
